fusions.name: Pounce from the Rafters
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles onto the target and rakes it for 13 damage, leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Your movement speed rises by 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Toying Rake
fusions.desc: Rakes the target with both spurs for 20 damage, 50% more for each of your afflictions on it, which it uses up, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Feathered Hush
fusions.desc: You and your allies are veiled for 5 seconds and move 11% faster. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Ninth Squawk
fusions.desc: Once every 180 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused, leaving you at 1 health.
